### Fixed
- **`muster auth token` renews an access token in its last minute instead of answering `auth_required`.** The CLI's token store calls a token invalid 60 s before it expires, while the transport renewed only a token past its expiry: a command in that minute connected with the old token unrenewed, then found no valid token and answered `auth_required: authentication required … sign in with muster auth login`, although the refresh token was good and a call a minute later went through. A client that runs `muster auth token` per call (a script, a watch reading through `call_tool`) read that as a lost sign-in. The transport now sees the expiry the store judges by, so a connection in the last minute renews the token first. Without a refresh token, or with one the authorization server refuses, the command still answers `auth_required`. ([#1450](https://github.com/giantswarm/muster/issues/1450))
